Product rationale for these choices is not supplied in the inputs and must not be invented; the inputs state behavior and scope boundaries, not why the owner chose them.

- Promotion partition (steer/queue promotion boundaries, FIFO/one-at-a-time queue promotion, steer coalescing in admission order, allowance reset, `Prompted` visibility): supported by all three ranges, especially session.md:155-185 for delivery detail.
